name: Kelpline Logistics AquaReclaim DF-9 Greywater Cascade Purification Unit
product_name: Kelpline Logistics AquaReclaim DF-9 Greywater Cascade Purification Unit
description:
The AquaReclaim DF-9 is a building-integrated greywater recovery and purification unit designed for installation in the utility cores of mid-rise residential and commercial structures throughout GLMZ. The system intercepts wastewater from sinks, showers, laundry, and HVAC condensate lines before they reach the municipal sewer outflow, passing the water through a four-stage cascade: mechanical filtration, a bioreactor membrane seeded with engineered Helix Biosystems microbial consortia, UV-C sterilization, and a final electrochemical polishing cell that strips residual pharmaceutical compounds — a critical requirement given the high concentration of Lazarus Pharmaceuticals metabolites documented in GLMZ's water table since the 2070s. Purified output is certified for non-potable reuse including toilet flushing, irrigation of VertiRoot VX-22 columns, and industrial cleaning, reducing a building's municipal water draw by 55–70%.

The DF-9's bioreactor membrane is the system's most technically sophisticated and commercially controlled component — the microbial consortia are Helix Biosystems proprietary strains licensed to Kelpline under an exclusive supply agreement, and the membrane cassettes require replacement every 14–18 months at a cost that represents the majority of the system's ongoing operational expense. Kelpline's service subsidiary handles cassette replacement under mandatory maintenance contracts, with the used cassettes classified as biological waste requiring Kelpline-licensed disposal — a classification that conveniently prevents third-party analysis of what the membranes have filtered out of a building's water supply over their service life.

The DF-9 was initially positioned as a premium sustainability feature for Tier 2 corporate residential developments, but water pricing increases driven by GLMZ's ongoing freshwater management crisis have pushed the system's economics into viability for Tier 3 multi-unit buildings operating as cooperatives or under building management contracts. A significant grey market has emerged around refurbished membrane cassettes — technically illegal under the biological waste classification, but widely used in lower-district installations where the alternative is either unprocessed greywater reuse or full municipal water dependency at rates that consume 18–25% of a lower-tier household's monthly allocation budget.
base_technologies: engineered microbial consortia for water remediation
enables: pharmaceutical compound removal from residential water streams
social_impact: The AquaReclaim DF-9 has introduced a new axis of infrastructure dependency in GLMZ, with Kelpline Logistics positioned as a critical intermediary in residential water security. Buildings that have reduced their municipal draw by 60% find themselves equally exposed to Kelpline's membrane cassette supply chain — a leverage point the company has exercised during labor disputes and service contract renegotiations. The mandatory disposal classification for used cassettes has also created a significant information asymmetry: Kelpline holds fourteen years of filtered compound data from thousands of buildings, representing a detailed chemical record of pharmaceutical use, industrial contamination exposure, and health conditions across the city's residential stock that has never been disclosed to building occupants.
story_hooks: A refurbished membrane cassette sold on the grey market contains microbial colonies that are not Helix Biosystems proprietary strains — they are something older, something that predates Kelpline's founding, and they are extraordinarily effective at breaking down a specific class of compounds

Kelpline's used cassette disposal facility has been accepting cassettes but not processing them — a warehouse in the port district contains fourteen years of biological waste from thousands of buildings, unsecured

A building's DF-9 unit has begun producing purified output that tests positive for a trace compound not present in the building's water inputs — something is being added by the bioreactor membrane, not removed
A Kelpline logistics driver has been quietly collecting water samples from DF-9 output lines across a specific district and delivering them to an address that doesn't appear in any corporate registry
